requirement: Effective-dated permanent security and issuer identifiers plus ticker, exchange, share class and security-type flags
acceptance_criterion: At least 99.9% one-to-one eligible security-day joins; all gold ticker-reuse/name-change cases resolve; no unexplained overlaps

requirement: Active and inactive US listings with listing/delisting dates and venue history
acceptance_criterion: No current-constituent reconstruction; protocol evidence-tier history; universe counts reconcile by date

requirement: Unadjusted OHLC, official close, volume, shares/market cap, returns with and without distributions, calendar and spread evidence
acceptance_criterion: At least 99.5% expected eligible security-days present or reason-coded; zero duplicate keys; no silent forward-fill

requirement: Date, reason, last tradable value, delisting return/proceeds when known, merger link and missing flag
acceptance_criterion: Every gold delisting represented; attainable terminal treatment; missing return never silently zeroed; coverage sensitivity reported

requirement: Splits, dividends including specials, return of capital, rights/spin-offs, mergers/exchanges and event dates
acceptance_criterion: All gold events represented; daily reconstructed total return within 1 bp on at least 99.9% audited days and 5 bp per audited year; no double count

requirement: Annual and quarterly as-reported and standardized values with units, periods, fiscal labels, form/accession and source
acceptance_criterion: Every used fact has full provenance; completeness reported by date and sector; no future backfill

requirement: SEC acceptance/filing and provider availability timestamps, timezone, amendment and form type
acceptance_criterion: Every used fact has available_at; zero future-at-cutoff violations; after-close filings wait until the next eligible session

requirement: Original values and revisions with version/effective dates and amendment links
acceptance_criterion: Historical as-of snapshots reconstructable; later revision cannot appear earlier; latest-restated-only is prototype-only

requirement: Fiscal mapping, TTM inputs, last-publication date and stale/missing flags
acceptance_criterion: No duplicate quarter in TTM; balance/flow semantics tested; every included fact passes deterministic maximum age

requirement: Effective add/remove dates, total-return indexes, investable-proxy distributions and expense history
acceptance_criterion: Gold membership exact; zero current-constituent leakage; identical contribution/cash/fill conventions

requirement: Bulk/API, schema, release notes, version/snapshot, retrieval timestamp, query/config and checksums
acceptance_criterion: Immutable raw extracts; rerunnable during license; complete lineage; corrections are new vintages

requirement: Authorized research, local storage/retention, aggregate publication, redistribution, API/bulk rights, quote and renewal
acceptance_criterion: Written terms allow intended research and reproducibility; first-year/renewal costs documented; post-lapse loss explicit
